body:
Claim: PM loop — maintainer direct-dispatch channel (2026-08-10 standing authorization).
Provenance: maintainer, 2026-09-06, live chat with this session — 「感觉 单库多组织隔离是开源基本需求，如果迁移回开源项目成本有多大」 then 「直接立专题卡派发处理吧」.
Session: `6679d191-11f4-465b-b322-0e0409d76793`
Branch: **none for phase 1** — the deliverable is a line-level classification posted on this card. ⛔ No code PR opens until that classification is accepted.
Worktree: **sibling level** for the cloud side (`/Users/zhuangjianguo/Documents/GitHub/cloud-issue-16130`), ⛔ never under `.claude/worktrees` — cloud resolves dependencies by relative path.
Domain: `domain:services` provisional (the code lands as a plugin); ⚠️ phase 2 also touches `docs/adr/**`, a **governed surface** — draft PR, human merge, and it is part of this work rather than a follow-up.
File surface, phase 1: read-only over `cloud/packages/organizations/**` and the open consumers. ⛔ Nothing is edited in phase 1.
Container & model: L, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — a two-repo move across a commercial boundary, where the expensive mistake is moving one line too many.
Clause-②: **yes, expected at phase 2** — a new open package registering a service the open core already consumes widens the published surface. Re-judged from the diff at review.
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `cloud/packages/organizations` (REST search 2026-09-06); #14508 (the ADR-0081 open mirror) is `pm:queue`, unstarted and unassigned — ⚠️ its writer and this card's phase 2 must not both write that record; whoever moves second adopts the other's text.

os-dev-report

**Phase 1 — line-level disposition of all 1660 lines. No code moved, no branch, no PR.**

Read against `origin/main` in both repos (cloud `daaac081`, objectstack `932acc3d`). ⚠️ The local cloud checkout at `/Users/zhuangjianguo/Documents/GitHub/cloud` is **75 commits behind** `origin/main`; every line number and quote below is read through `git show origin/main:PATH`, never the working tree.

## Verdict: the estimate survives. ~1350 → **1300 move, 342 stay, 18 deleted.**

None of the four stop conditions fired. No third coupling point, `membership-policy-gate.ts` is cleanly separable from entitlement, the open package needs nothing from `security-enterprise`, and the movable size is within 3.7% of the card's figure.

## Which measurements held

| card's measurement | verdict |
|---|---|
| 8 non-test files, 1660 lines | ✅ **held** — 508+416+306+107+28+135+116+44 = 1660 exactly |
| per-file licence headers as tabulated | ✅ **held** — all 8 verified line 1 by line 1 |
| coupling is exactly two points, both entitlement | ✅ **held at the import level**, and mechanically: a sweep of every `import`/`from` across all 8 files finds `@objectstack/security-enterprise` at exactly `multi-org-license-gate.ts:51-56` and `index.ts:41`. ⚠️ **Refined** — see "the seam the count misses" below |
| 4 of 5 dependencies are `link:` into the framework | ✅ **held** — `core`, `plugin-auth`, `spec`, `types` are `link:`; only `security-enterprise` is `workspace:*` |
| `organizations-plugin.ts` migrated verbatim from open `plugin-org-scoping`; open core consumes it unchanged | ✅ **held** — docblock line 64; open core's `getService('org-scoping')` at `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:589,601`, `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:1250`, `deployment-org-scoping-entitlement.ts`, and `requiresService: 'org-scoping'` at `platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts:86`, `account.app.ts:144`, `dashboards/system_overview.dashboard.ts:69` |
| ~1350 lines move, 306 stay | ⚠️ **corrected to 1300 / 342** — the 36-line delta is `index.ts`'s two cloud blocks, which a whole-file count could not see |

## The line-level disposition

| file | lines | move as-is | move with changes | deleted | stays in cloud |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `organizations-plugin.ts` | 508 | 480 | 10 | 18 | 0 |
| `membership-policy-gate.ts` | 416 | 407 | 9 | 0 | 0 |
| `multi-org-license-gate.ts` | 306 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **306** |
| `index.ts` | 107 | 59 | 12 | 0 | **36** |
| `manifest.ts` | 28 | 24 | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| `claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` | 135 | **135** | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` | 116 | **116** | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `ensure-default-organization.ts` | 44 | **44** | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| **total** | **1660** | **1265** | **35** | **18** | **342** |

Moving = 1265 + 35 = **1300**.

### The three Apache-2.0 files — 295 lines, move as-is, zero edits

`claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` (135), `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` (116), `ensure-default-organization.ts` (44). Their only non-local imports are `type ServiceObject` from `@objectstack/spec/data` and `ensureDefaultOrganization` / `EnsureDefaultOrganizationResult` from `@objectstack/plugin-auth` — both verified present on objectstack `origin/main` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2870`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/ensure-default-organization.ts:276`). The headers already say Apache-2.0. **Nothing in these three needs touching.**

### `organizations-plugin.ts` (508) — 480 as-is, 10 changed, 18 deleted

**What it registers, beyond the service.** Answering the card's question directly: `init()` registers exactly two things — `ctx.registerService('org-scoping', this)` (line 183) and one `manifest` registration of an **empty** object list (`organizationsObjects = []`, lines 185-190). `start()` adds two ObjectQL middlewares (insert auto-stamp at 257-291; per-org seed pipeline at 294-406), one `kernel:bootstrapped` hook (the membership gate, 225-232), one `kernel:ready` hook plus a third middleware for the default-org bootstrap (409-450).

**How much of that is cloud-shaped: none of it.** The complete set of services this file touches is `org-scoping`, `manifest`, `objectql`, `metadata`, `seed-datasets`, `seed-replayer` — every one an open framework service. A sweep for `sys_environment`, `kernel-manager`, `control-plane`, `environment-registry`, Cloudflare/D1/turso, `service-cloud` and `objectos` across all 8 files returns **only comment prose** citing cloud files for provenance — zero code references. The only env vars named anywhere in the moving files are `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY` and `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY`, all open-framework knobs. `OS_LICENSE_KEY` appears **only** in `multi-org-license-gate.ts`.

**Deleted — 18 lines, the entitlement excision:**
- **line 8** — `import { assertMultiOrgEntitled } from './multi-org-license-gate.js';`
- **lines 153-169** — the LICENSE gate comment block and its `assertMultiOrgEntitled();` call, the first statement of the constructor. The constructor itself survives (152, 170-173) to set `this.opts`.

**Move with changes — 10 lines, all prose, two of them boundary-critical:**
- **line 1** — proprietary header → Apache-2.0.
- **lines 63-65** — "the enterprise multi-organization runtime (ADR-0081 D2; migrated verbatim from the open `plugin-org-scoping`, which the framework no longer ships)". The parenthetical inverts on this move; it becomes the record of the round trip.
- ⛔ **lines 128-130** — "that is a PACKAGING decision, and it belongs here, in the commercial runtime, rather than hard-coded in open core." This is ADR-0105 D12's argument for putting `supportedPostures` in the closed package, and moving the file **contradicts it in place**. The declaration itself (line 145, `['group', 'isolated']`) moves as-is and is correct for an open install — an open deployment is entitled to both walled postures. Only the justification changes, and it should say so explicitly rather than be quietly deleted.
- ⛔ **lines 134-136** — "narrowing the boundary later — selling `group` as a higher tier than `isolated`, **gating it behind a licence flag**, running a trial — becomes a one-line edit HERE." Left verbatim in an open package this reads as an invitation to add exactly the licence check hard boundary 3 forbids. **Must be reworded, not merely carried over.**

**Deliberately kept verbatim:**
- **line 117** `name = 'com.objectstack.organizations'` — anchored by cloud `service-cloud/src/control-plane-preset.ts:691` (`lazyPlugin('com.objectstack.organizations', ...)`) and by open fixtures at `packages/types/src/node.test.ts:176,552`, `packages/verify/src/harness.host-resolution.test.ts:44`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/enterprise-organizations.test.ts:98`. The plugin id is a second anchor alongside the service name; changing it is a separate decision with its own blast radius.
- **lines 177-183** — the "service name stays `org-scoping` ON PURPOSE" comment and the registration. Boundary 4, satisfied by doing nothing.
- **lines 52-59, 378-405** — the cloud#1345 no-donor-clone invariant and its ⛔ markers. These are the most safety-critical comments in the file and they travel unchanged.

### `membership-policy-gate.ts` (416) — the file whose depth was unmeasured

**It separates from entitlement completely.** Its only two imports are `isMembershipPolicy, MEMBERSHIP_POLICIES` from `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (verified at `reconcile-membership.ts:63,68`) and `resolveTenancyPosture` from `@objectstack/types` (verified at `types/src/env.ts:145`). Zero references to `security-enterprise`, to `multi-org-license-gate.ts`, or to any entitlement symbol. The header states the independence as a designed non-feature, lines 61-64: no env escape hatch, "**and neither does a licence**". It adjudicates a *declaration*, not an authorization — it reads the settings service's own `source` field for `auth.membership_policy` and refuses `default`. Its services are `auth` and `settings`, both open.

**No enterprise-only assumption survives inspection.** What looks enterprise-only is the refuse-rather-than-warn rationale at lines 29-32 — the 2026-08-04 ruling that "EE has NO deployed customers — zero breakage surface". That argument does not transfer to open, but its **conclusion still holds for a different and verifiable reason**: today no open install can reach a walled posture at all. `serve.ts:3700` computes `multiTenant = tenancyPosture !== 'single'`, so **both** `group` and `isolated` require the cloud package; absent it, `serve.ts:3747` prints the ADR-0093 D5 fatal and `process.exit(1)`, and the only way past is `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY=1`, which leaves `orgMod` undefined so this gate never runs either. The breakage surface at the moment of the move is genuinely zero — it just needs to be argued from that fact instead of from EE's customer count.

**Move with changes — 9 prose lines:** line 1 (header), line 8 ("an EE deployment" → "a deployment"), lines 29-32 (re-argue zero-breakage from the boot-refusal fact above), lines 55 and 111 (citations of cloud-private paths `service-cloud` and `packages/objectos-runtime/src/artifact-kernel-factory.ts`, dangling for an open reader), and **line 337**.

Line 337 deserves its own note. The fatal message says, at 336-337:

> This is NOT a licensing failure and NOT a missing package: the multi-org runtime is present, **licensed**, and about to enforce the wall.

Dropping `, licensed,` from line 337 is the whole edit. It is test-safe: the pin at `membership-policy-gate.test.ts:368` matches `/NOT a licensing failure/`, which lives on line 336 and is untouched. Keeping the sentence would not breach boundary 3 — prose is not a check — but it would be false on an open-only install.

**The other 407 lines move as-is**, including the whole 100-line message builder whose text is pinned by 18 assertions in the suite.

### `index.ts` (107) — the file that genuinely splits three ways

- **Stays in cloud — lines 26-41 (16)**: the `MULTI_NODE_GATE_CARRIER_PACKAGES` comment and the bare `import '@objectstack/security-enterprise';`. Boundary 2 — the open package must not acquire this. Verified against `service-cluster/src/multi-node-gate-mount.ts:70-73`, which still names both packages.
- **Stays in cloud — lines 88-107 (20)**: the licence-gate export block, all twelve `multi-org-license-gate.js` symbols. Consumed by `apps/objectos-ee/objectstack.config.ts:98` (`assertWalledPostureEntitled`, `isMultiOrgLicenseError`), both EE showcase configs (`grantDevelopmentMultiOrgEntitlement`), and `service-cloud/src/control-plane-organizations.ts:40` (`grantFirstPartyMultiOrgEntitlement`). Cloud's package must keep exporting these under the same specifier.
- **Move with changes — 12 lines**: line 1 (header); lines 4-6 (the "enterprise / closed-source successor" framing); lines 17-23 ("The open framework mounts this package best-effort by name when `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true`" — false for the open package, which `serve` will reach differently, see phase 2 below); line 45 (the transitional-alias comment, whose migration direction inverts — the `OrgScopingPlugin` alias itself at 46-47 is worth keeping and moves as-is).
- **Move as-is — 59 lines**: the plugin, claim-helper, ensure and manifest re-exports (42-44, 46-66) and the whole membership-gate export block (67-87).

### `manifest.ts` (28) — 24 as-is, 4 changed

Changed: line 1 (header), line 4 (package name in the docblock), line 23 (`name: 'Organizations (Enterprise)'`), line 25 (description opens "Enterprise multi-organization runtime").

Two lines that look cloud-shaped and are **not**, both move as-is:
- **line 22 `defaultDatasource: 'cloud'`** — this is the open framework's own convention for `scope: 'system'` packages, documented at objectstack `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:315` ("Packages with this scope should also set `defaultDatasource: 'cloud'`") and used by open `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts:392`. It names a datasource, not this repo.
- **line 9 `ORGANIZATIONS_PLUGIN_ID`** — see the plugin-id anchors above.

### `multi-org-license-gate.ts` (306) — stays in cloud, in full

All 306 lines. Boundary 1, no line-level analysis needed beyond confirming nothing else in the package depends on it except the two seams already named.

## ⚠️ The seam the "exactly two" count misses

"Coupling to cloud is exactly two" is true and I verified it mechanically — but it counts **cross-package imports**, and the move has a third touch point that lives **inside** the package: `organizations-plugin.ts` imports `assertMultiOrgEntitled` (line 8) and calls it as the first statement of its constructor (line 168). The 508-line file that moves is wired to the 306-line file that stays.

This is not a stop condition — it is not a dependency on `security-enterprise`, and it is exactly where the split is supposed to happen. But it has one consequence the card should carry into phase 2: **`organizations-plugin.ts` cannot move as-is**, and cloud must re-establish a *construction-time* refusal without the open package offering a hook for it (boundary 1's "do not leave a hook a host could use to re-add one" rules out any injectable-assertion parameter).

The shape that satisfies this without any open-side seam: cloud's package keeps `multi-org-license-gate.ts` and exports its own `OrganizationsPlugin` that extends the open class and calls `assertMultiOrgEntitled()` in its own constructor before `super()`-side work. Cloud-side code calling a cloud-side gate; the open package gains nothing and offers nothing. It also preserves the two existing consumers byte-for-byte: `serve.ts:3782`'s `new orgMod.OrganizationsPlugin()` and its two-stage classifier, which deliberately keys on **which stage threw** rather than the error's shape, and `artifact-kernel-factory.ts:862-866`'s `new organizations.OrganizationsPlugin()` plus `isMultiOrgLicenseError`. Both keep working untouched.

## Phase 2 on the open side — what an open-only `isolated` boot would take

⛔ Not built. Scope only. The card budgets the move; it does not budget this, and this is the larger half.

1. **`packages/cli/src/utils/tenancy-posture-hints.ts:117`** — `ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` is one hard-coded spelling, and this file's own header records a maintainer ruling (2026-08-27, #12579) that the spelling is single-sourced *here*, may not be read from the spec roster, and may not be imported from the `serve` command. Teaching `serve` a second, open candidate is therefore a governed edit at a spot with a standing ruling on it.
2. **`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:3700-3800`** — the two-stage import/mount. Stage 1 resolves through `importFromHost` because the package is cloud-private; an open registrar lives in the framework workspace and resolves differently. And the ADR-0093 D5 semantics change meaning: once an open registrar exists, "the multi-org runtime is absent" can no longer be the normal state for `isolated`, so `formatOrganizationsAbsentFatal`, the install remedy text and `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY`'s scope all need re-deriving.
3. **`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts:237-243`** — the roster row for `@objectstack/organizations` is `edition: 'enterprise'` and its note says `serve` loads it off the tenancy posture. That note becomes wrong. A new open package likely takes **no** row (the roster is for out-of-repo `plugins[]`-wired runtimes), but the drift test in `serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts` reads both the row and `MULTI_NODE_GATE_CARRIER_PACKAGES`, whose header describes both carriers as "enterprise runtimes the spec roster declares".
4. **Pin tests holding the spelling or the prose**, all of which redden together: `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts`, `doctor-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts`, `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts` (a named-literal sweep that keeps `'@objectstack/organizations'` in an expected set), `serve-capability-vocabulary.test.ts`, `serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e.test.ts`, `serve-organizations-mount-failure.e2e.test.ts`, `packages/types/src/node.test.ts`, `packages/verify/src/harness.host-resolution.test.ts`.
5. **No change at all** to the consumers, which is the card's central claim and it holds: `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:589,601`, `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:1250`, `plugin-security/src/deployment-org-scoping-entitlement.ts`, and the three `requiresService: 'org-scoping'` nav gates all probe by service name. ℹ️ One thing to carry: `OrgScopingEntitlement` has grown two keys beyond `supportedPostures` — `platformGlobalObjects` and `suppressUnboundedOrgAdminGrant` — both fail-closed when absent, so the moving plugin (which declares neither) is unaffected, but the open package now owns that declaration surface.
6. **`MULTI_NODE_GATE_CARRIER_PACKAGES` needs no edit** — both names stay, boundary 2 satisfied by inaction.
7. ⚠️ **The acceptance matrix has no open home, and this is the unbudgeted item.** The card's acceptance — an ex-member's API key and session refused, a member reads only its own organization — is exercised today only by cloud's `apps/ee-tenant-crm-showcase/test/isolated-posture.dogfood.test.ts` and `apps/ee-group-showcase/test/*.dogfood.test.ts`, both of which boot the real runtime after calling `grantDevelopmentMultiOrgEntitlement`. On the open side the nearest thing is `packages/qa/dogfood/test/enterprise-organizations.test.ts`, which tests only the *availability probe* using stand-in packages on disk — it never raises a wall. A grep for a walled `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE` across open `examples/`, `apps/` and `packages/qa/` returns one unrelated dogfood file. **An open walled-posture acceptance app has to be built from nothing**, and until it exists the card's own acceptance criterion cannot be evaluated in the open repo.
8. **ADR-0081 D2 amendment** — as the card says, part of this work, governed surface, human merge. Open mirror #14508.

## Tests (not part of the 1660, stated for phase 2 planning)

8 test files, 2081 lines. Every entitlement reference in the five moving-side suites is a **test-setup grant that simply deletes** on the open side — a one-line `grantDevelopmentMultiOrgEntitlement(...)` plus its import, at `organizations-plugin.test.ts:5,11`, `walled-default-org-self-registrant.pin.test.ts:40,43`, `org-creation-no-cross-org-copy.test.ts:35,43`, `membership-policy-gate.test.ts:24-26,32`. There is nothing to grant when there is no gate. The single exception is `membership-policy-gate.test.ts:367`, `expect(isMultiOrgLicenseError(err)).toBe(false)` — an assertion discriminating this refusal from the licensing one, which has no counterpart in an open tree and drops. `multi-org-license-gate.test.ts` (344) and `multi-node-gate-carrier.test.ts` (37) stay in cloud with their subjects.

## Nothing was written

⛔ No file edited in either repo, no branch, no PR. Both repos read through `origin/main` only; the cloud working tree was never used and never touched.

## PM answers the three open questions — **A, A, A**, with one correction of scope on the third

Phase 1 is **accepted**. The estimate survived at 1300 move / 342 stay / 18 delete against the card's ~1350, none of the four stop conditions fired, and the classification was taken through `git show origin/main:PATH` on both repos rather than a working tree that is 75 commits behind — the discipline that makes the readings usable.

### Q1 — the constructor's `assertMultiOrgEntitled()` → **A: cloud subclasses**

Cloud's package exports its own `OrganizationsPlugin` extending the open class and calls the gate in its own constructor. It satisfies hard boundary 1 exactly — **cloud code, cloud gate, and the open package neither gains nor offers a hook** — and it is the only option that leaves `serve.ts`'s two-stage classifier untouched, since that classifier keys on *which stage threw* rather than on the error's shape. ⛔ B changes the `new orgMod.OrganizationsPlugin()` call shape that two call sites depend on for no gain; ⛔ C is the forbidden hook.

### Q2 — the ADR-0105 D12 paragraph → **A: reword, and the amendment carries D12 too**

⭐ And the seat's separate observation is upgraded to a **requirement**: lines 134-136 — *"gating it behind a licence flag … becomes a one-line edit HERE"* — ⛔ **must** be reworded regardless of what happens to 128-130. Left verbatim in an open file, that sentence is a written invitation to add the licence check hard boundary 3 forbids, sitting in the exact file where it would go. Leaving it would be worse than the drift it describes.

### Q3 — the acceptance matrix → **A: its own card, but it is far smaller than estimated**

⚠️ **The premise is corrected by measurement.** The report says the matrix "has no open home" and that building one is *"unbudgeted work larger than the move itself"*. Measured on objectstack `origin/main`: **the matrix already has an open home** — `packages/rest/src/single-kernel-isolated-api-key-matrix.test.ts` and `single-kernel-isolated-session-org-claim-matrix.test.ts`, the two suites the cross-organization repairs pinned, both driving a live `isolated` posture at REST level.

What they do **not** do is produce that posture. Both raise it with a hand-written stub:

```ts
const tenancyServiceProvider = async () => ({ posture: 'isolated' });
```

⇒ The open tree already proves **the wall behaves correctly given a posture**. What nothing open proves is that **anything can produce one** — which is precisely what this card moves. So the acceptance card is not "build a walled showcase app"; it is *"run the existing open matrices against the real open `org-scoping` registrar instead of the stub"*. Filed separately as decided, and ⛔ it stays a **blocking acceptance**: phase 2's PR ⛔ must not claim the card's acceptance criterion is met, and must name that card as where it is discharged.

⇒ ⛔ C (porting cloud's showcase suites) is not needed for the acceptance and should not be scoped into it.

Dispatching phase 2 on this basis.

## The goal, stated by the maintainer — and measured against what is already open

Maintainer, 2026-09-06, live chat, verbatim:

> 迁移之后的效果应该是开源版就可以把元数据应用使用单库多租户的方式运行。

⇒ The bar is not "the `org-scoping` service can be registered". It is **an open-source-only install runs a metadata application in single-database multi-tenant mode**. Measured on `origin/main` against that bar, and the news is good — everything except the switch is already open:

| piece | where it is |
|---|---|
| the wall | **open** — `plugin-security/src/tenant-layer.ts`, the three postures in `packages/spec` |
| the posture knob | **open** — `resolveTenancyPosture()` in `packages/types` |
| organizations, invitations as objects | **open** — `platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`, `sys-invitation.object.ts` |
| org CRUD / membership / invite endpoints | **open** — better-auth's organization plugin is mounted in `plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:2795`, and `createOrganization` resolves in open `plugin-auth` (ADR-0081 **D1**: the open member-management basics own it) |
| the Setup surface for it | **open** — `requiresService: 'org-scoping'` gates in `setup-nav.contributions.ts`, `account.app.ts`, `system_overview.dashboard.ts`; they appear the moment the service registers |
| **the `org-scoping` registrar** | ⛔ **cloud-private** — the one missing piece |

⇒ The maintainer's stated effect is delivered by this card, and by this card alone. ⛔ No second migration is hiding behind it.

## ⭐ And the sharpest way to say what changes

Today an open-source install that sets `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` cannot enforce it. Its only way forward is **`OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY=1`** — the wall *configured but not enforced*, which is the precise shape this session spent the day closing three cross-organization defects against, and the shape ADR-0131 D9 refuses.

⇒ The acceptance on **#16137** is therefore stated at its sharpest, and phase 2 should be read against it: **an open-only install, `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, with `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY` UNSET, boots with the wall ACTIVE and enforces the matrix.** Today that is unsatisfiable — the degraded flag is the only way an open install reaches a walled posture at all, and it reaches it without a wall.
